summary: The PR fixes a regression issue with IsolationForest, but introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect.

issues.description: The change introduces a minor maintainability/readability defect by adding a private method without a clear reason for doing so.
The change does not add any tests for the new private method, which may lead to future regressions.
The change uses a slightly different naming convention for the private method, which is not consistent with the rest of the codebase.
